meta_description: Cobbler paver tiles 4x4 inch: small square pavers for a cobbled look on porches, paths, borders and driveways. Free sample on WhatsApp.
description:
These cobbler paver tiles 4x4 inch are small square paving pieces from Pak Clay that give porches, garden paths, borders and driveways a traditional cobbled look.

## How they look
At 4 by 4 inches, each piece is small, so a laid area shows a fine grid of joints much like an old cobbled street. The size makes it easy to follow curves, edge a lawn or frame a larger paved area, and it adds texture to entrances and courtyards.

## Where they work
- **Porches and house entrances** that want a cobbled finish.
- **Garden paths, borders and edging** around beds and lawns.
- **Driveways and courtyards**: for vehicle areas, confirm thickness and suitability with us first.

Cobblestone pavers in a small format suit fan, row and border patterns, and they are often used as a contrast band next to bigger pavers or tuff tiles.

## Good to know
- Size: 4 x 4 inch
- Type: paver / tuff tile
- Category: pavers tiles
- Thickness, colour options and coverage per square foot: confirm on enquiry

Small paver tiles rely on a well-compacted base, edge restraints and tight, fully filled joints, so plan the bedding before you buy. Our guide to [driveway tiles in Pakistan](/blog/driveway-tiles-in-pakistan-pavers-grass-grid-and-stone-options) covers bases and patterns, and [tuff tiles explained](/blog/tuff-tiles-explained-interlocking-paver-tiles-and-alternatives) compares paver types.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to check the size and surface, then send your area, use and city for a dated quote. Compare the [square paver tile 4x4 inch](/products/square-paver-tile-4x4-inch), or browse all [pavers tiles](/categories/pavers-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of cobbler paver tiles 4x4 inch in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the area, thickness, quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can 4x4 cobbler pavers take car traffic?
faqs.a: Small pavers are often used on driveways, but load depends on thickness, base and laying. Tell Pak Clay the use before ordering so the team can advise.

faqs.q: Cobbler pavers or larger 8x4 pavers: which should I use?
faqs.a: 4x4 cobblers give a fine cobbled look and follow curves easily; larger 8x4 pavers cover ground faster with fewer joints. Many designs use cobblers as borders around bigger pavers.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Cobbler Paver Tiles 4 x 4 inch" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
